title: The Six Stars
text: On the Shrine's roof, the monks read the six stars of the gods through bronze tubes, their lips moving silently. Tonight one star is missing. When a star goes out, they say, someone below dies before dawn. They look at each of you in turn.

options.label: The wisest reads the stars with the monks to learn whose death it means.

outcomes.text: The death will come soon. Now they know where.

options.label: Pray for the missing god, and ask the star to come back.

outcomes.text: The star returns, faintly. The monks breathe again.

options.label: Leave before the death comes; let it find someone else.

outcomes.text: You walk through the night and go further than you meant to. Nobody looks up.
